dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that's a ton of fish!

dialogues.speaker: Pania
dialogues.text: #Wait, don't move, {M#Big Bro}{F#Big Sis} Blondie! Those are bait to attract Flowcurrent Birds!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, attract Flowcurrent Birds?

dialogues.speaker: Pania
dialogues.text: Yeah! Iwai and I are waiting for the Flowcurrent Birds to return to shore. Not much else to do right now, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Iwai
dialogues.text: Hrroo, roooh!

dialogues.speaker: Pania
dialogues.text: Alright, come on, Iwai. You're a good kid, aren't you? Now be patient. There's no need to rush.

dialogues.speaker: Iwai
dialogues.text: Rroo...

dialogues.speaker: Pania
dialogues.text: Anyway, our original plan was to come down here to play. I mean, no one else usually comes down here other than Uncle Rongo anyway, so this is our super secret base... or something like that!

dialogues.speaker: Pania
dialogues.text: But we didn't think that these birds would steal a march on us today.

dialogues.speaker: Pania
dialogues.text: And that's why I've got all this fish ready to lure them over with. Flowcurrent Birds love the stuff!

choices.text: Really? They don't seem all that attracted by it.

response.speaker: Pania
response.text: Yeah. Could be that we're too far away, and they can't smell the fish? If only we could get 'em ashore somehow...

response.speaker: Pania
response.text: If Uncle Rongo was here, he'd say something like <color=#00E1FFFF>"Just boop them all ashore, why don't you?"</color>... Iwai and I don't have the raw strength for that though. They'd blow us away instead, I'd bet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm... Why don't we give that a try instead, {NICKNAME}? If we could get them to come ashore, they might be attracted to the fish then!

choices.text: I see, so "Paimon" is in fact a subspecies of Flowcurrent Bird...

response.speaker: Pania
response.text: Round like a roly-poly, and fond of fish... Yeah, I can see where you're coming from.

response.speaker: Iwai
response.text: Mmm! Mmmm!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? No! Anyway, back to the point — you haven't lured any Flowcurrent Birds over at all!

response.speaker: Pania
response.text: See you around, then! If you've got time, feel free to swing by and play, alright?

response.speaker: Paimon

dialogues.text: #Wow, they came after all! Thanks so much, {M#Big Bro}{F#Big Sis} Blondie!
